name: Dune Chat Monitor
description: Read-only live and history monitor for Dune: Awakening chat. The version-pinned companion collector follows dune-text-router Docker logs, persists allowed chat history in its own SQLite database, and exports generated UI JSON/history under the Console addon's web/live/ directory. Private/direct Whispers are excluded from both SQLite persistence and JSON exports.
author: WilliamDG
